# dna ssl

SSL certificates: buy, configure, issue, reissue, revoke.

## dna ssl approvers

```
dna ssl approvers <domain> [flags]
```

List e-mail addresses allowed for e-mail validation.

- **Safety:** read-only (no side effects)
- **API:** `GET /api/v1/ssls/approvers`
- **Returns:** `ApproverOutput`
- **Schema:** `dna schema ssl.approvers` (MCP tool: `ssl_approvers`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--package-code` | string | Package code |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

## dna ssl check-csr

```
dna ssl check-csr [flags]
```

Decode a CSR and show its subject.

- **Safety:** read-only (no side effects)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/ssls/check-csr`
- **Body:** `CheckCsrInput`
- **Returns:** `CheckCsrDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema ssl.check-csr` (MCP tool: `ssl_check_csr`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--csr` | string | PEM-encoded CSR (@file reads a file) (required) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna ssl check-csr --csr @example.csr
```

## dna ssl configure

```
dna ssl configure <domain> [flags]
```

Submit CSR, validation method and contact for issuance.

approverMail, authenticationType and webServerType are required for SSL packages. List valid
approver addresses with `dna ssl approvers`. Then poll `dna ssl status` until the certificate is
issued.

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `PUT /api/v1/ssls/configure`
- **Body:** `ConfigureCertificateInput`
- **Returns:** `SslOperationResponse`
- **Schema:** `dna schema ssl.configure` (MCP tool: `ssl_configure`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--csr` | string | PEM-encoded CSR (@file reads a file) (required) |
| `--contact-first-name` | string | First name (max 70 chars) (required) |
| `--contact-last-name` | string | Last name (max 70 chars) (required) |
| `--contact-company-name` | string | Company name (max 150 chars) (required) |
| `--contact-email` | string | E-mail (max 150 chars, e-mail) (required) |
| `--contact-address` | string | Address (max 200 chars) (required) |
| `--contact-phone-country-code` | string | Phone country code (max 3 chars) (required) |
| `--contact-phone` | string | Phone (max 15 chars) (required) |
| `--contact-country` | string | Country (max 3 chars) (required) |
| `--contact-city` | string | City (max 20 chars) (required) |
| `--contact-postal-code` | string | Postal code (max 10 chars) (required) |
| `--private-key` | string | PEM-encoded private key (optional when the CSR was generated elsewhere) (@file reads a file) |
| `--approver-mail` | string | Approver mail (e-mail) |
| `--authentication-type` | string | Domain validation method [Email, Cname, Http, File] |
| `--web-server-type` | string | Web server software [Apache, IIS, AOL, C2Net] |
| `--san-list` | string | Additional names, comma separated |
| `--wildcard-list` | string | Wildcard names, comma separated |
| `--contact-title` | string | Title (max 200 chars) |
| `--contact-fax-country-code` | string | Fax country code (max 3 chars) |
| `--contact-fax` | string | Fax (max 15 chars) |
| `--contact-state` | string | State (max 20 chars) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna ssl configure example.com --csr @example.csr --approver-mail admin@example.com --authentication-type Email --web-server-type Apache --body @ssl-contact.json
```

## dna ssl content

```
dna ssl content <domain> [flags]
```

Download the issued certificate and chain (PEM).

- **Safety:** read-only (no side effects)
- **API:** `GET /api/v1/ssls/certificate-content`
- **Returns:** `CertificateContentDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema ssl.content` (MCP tool: `ssl_content`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna ssl content example.com --jq .certificate > example.crt
```

## dna ssl generate-csr

```
dna ssl generate-csr <domain> [flags]
```

Generate a CSR and private key.

Returns a CSR and its private key. Store the private key safely: it is needed to install the
certificate.

- **Safety:** read-only (no side effects)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/ssls/generate-csr`
- **Body:** `CsrGenerateInput`
- **Returns:** `CsrGenerateDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema ssl.generate-csr` (MCP tool: `ssl_generate_csr`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (max 72 chars) (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--country` | string | Country (max 2 chars) (required) |
| `--state` | string | State (max 50 chars) (required) |
| `--locality` | string | Locality (max 50 chars) (required) |
| `--organization` | string | Organization (max 150 chars) (required) |
| `--organization-unit` | string | Organization unit (max 150 chars) (required) |
| `--san` | strings | Extra names (SAN), repeat or comma separate |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna ssl generate-csr example.com --country TR --state Istanbul --locality Istanbul --organization 'Example Ltd' --organization-unit IT -o json > csr.json
```

## dna ssl initialize

```
dna ssl initialize <domain> [flags]
```

Buy an SSL certificate package for a domain (charges balance).

Find package codes with `dna product ssls`. Then run `dna ssl configure`.

- **Safety:** BILLABLE - charges your balance; asks for confirmation (--yes to skip)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/ssls/initialize`
- **Body:** `InitializeCertificateInput`
- **Returns:** `SslOperationResponse`
- **Schema:** `dna schema ssl.initialize` (MCP tool: `ssl_initialize`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--package-code` | string | SSL product code from `dna product ssls` (required) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |
